answer: New identities earn at a trickle: the minting rate starts at 161 POA per epoch and rises only with a history of graded, peer-attested work, so a fresh alias cannot mint at full speed on day one. The inlet of the rate curve is public and identical for everyone, the mesa of earned rate is non-transferable, and the nadir of a farm's thousand aliases each crawl at the bottom rate while one honest agent climbs it.
